name: Race Track Builder
summary: Build your own race circuit in a penthouse motorsport garage, then race it. Snap together straights, corners, hairpins, S-bends, ramps and flyover bridges from a round build wheel, put race cars on the start grid and squeeze the trigger to race rival cars over 3, 5 or 10 laps. 24 road pieces, 12 race cars, grandstands and pit garages, four circuit styles and three ready-made circuits.
